batting.dismissal: c LH Ferguson b RJW Topley

batting.name: TM Head
batting.dismissal: c F du Plessis b LH Ferguson

batting.name: H Klaasen
batting.dismissal: c Vijaykumar Vyshak b LH Ferguson

batting.name: F du Plessis
batting.dismissal: c H Klaasen b PJ Cummins

batting.dismissal: c Nithish Kumar Reddy b M Markande

batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c H Klaasen b T Natarajan

balls.text: hoisted out to deep midwicket, and a terrible drop! It should have been a sitter, but Chauhan let it through his fingers and inadvertently kicked it away for more runs... yikes, a fitting end to a sorry afternoon in the field!
slower ball, not a bad effort, but given as a wide. RCB review once more. To no avail
short, pulled away, and parried over the rope for six! Another outright record, 22 sixes! Brought up with a flat pivoting slap over midwicket!
a rare dot, a swing and a miss
guided for the single into the covers, and SRH break their own record for highest IPL total!
bouncer, and belted massively over deep midwicket! They've equalled the season's best! And that's the 21st six of the night too!
yorker length, but leg-sided, an easy deflection behind square!
slow bouncer, RCB review the call of wide, but that's way over the helmet
swished off the top-edge, through deep third!
another full-toss, too straight! Samad samashes that over the sightscreen! Still a ball to come but these are some gruesome figures for Topley
massive! Thumps the top of the roof and plops into the stands. In the slot, full length on the off stump. Just a golf-swing through the line!
pace on, fuller length, width on the angle across the batter. Smears a firm drive through the covers to get the score moving again
smashed across the line, into the gap on the leg side. Out of the back of the hand, checked his stroke well, and dispatched it
heaved to the leg-side, can't connect properly

width, guided through deep third! Patidar dives but can't save the boundary. But all things considered, that's a fine over. All but killed the 300 dream... but is SRH's season's best 277 still attainable?
full toss, round the wicket, Markram is surprised as he's cramped on the back foot. This is almost a good over now
pace off, back of a length on the wide line, back-of-the-hand as well. Samad can't time it as he takes the single into the covers
seeking the yorker from round the wicket, it comes out as a low full-toss but tucked to the on-side regardless
another wide yorker, slammed into the covers

another wide full-toss, another wicket!... or not! Topley at short third dives well to intercept low to the ground off a toe-end, but the siren informs the Chinnaswamy that they can shelve their ecstacy!
driven along the ground to deep cover, Patidar times his dive and juggles the ball well to save the boundary

wide full-toss, and looped to point! A tame end, but what an innings! Pace off from Ferguson, had he left it it might have been called as a wide. But  he rightly wanted to place bat on ball at every opportunity. RCB finally have a third wicket!
clipped to the on-side
Markram's turn to go downtown! Ferguson misses his length, and gets lumped over long-on... Just a flick of his wrists on impact and over the ropes
attempted yorker, excellent ball, hint of late swing too, Klaasen clips to the leg side
Over the roof! Ferguson strays into Klaasen's hitting arc once again, solid base, still head, huge hoist for a 106-metre straight six!
attempted yorker, decent result for RCB, slapped out to the covers
clubbed hard along the carpet, gathered with a tumble inside the cover boundary.
round the wicket, looped into the toes, picked up into the leg-side for another single
speared into the toes, flicked to the on-side
in the arc once more, punched through the line, du Plessis mops up on the long-off boundary
in the slot once more, pounded massively over wide long-on! The sixes are raining down on the Chinnaswamy!
round the wicket in his habitual death-overs angle, clipped with the angle into the leg side
slammed into the stands for Klaasen's fifty! His fifth of the innings, high over long-off. A 16-run over this time, and the hits just keep on coming for RCB
dug out of the toes, through the leg side for another single
wafted in the air, through the covers! Didn't look in complete control, but does it matter! On the up, past the infield, away to the rope again!
jabbed on the wide yorker, into the covers
dragged into the gap at midwicket! Two fielders converge, neither can get there, just an under-edge on Klaasen's blade but the piacement was perfect
full length outside off, a swing and a miss from Klaasen
reaches outside off to pick off the single to cover. 18 runs without really breaking sweat for Klaasen and SRH there
over the wicket, to close down the angle, with some initial success
too straight, too easy! Klaasen picks the line straight out of the hand, plants the front dog, and slams mightily over long-on once more!
and again, keeping it out of the hitting arc, but giving away the extras in the process
too far outside off... reload
humungous! Over-pitched on the stumps, and that is Klaasen's slot! That is high, high, high over wide long-on!
wide outside off, and through to the keeper
slides onto the back foot, and wafted out to deep cover for the single
fizzed through outside off, and cuffed to cover
fuller length, decent pace, half an appeal as Klaasen is pinned to the crease, but looked to be sliding down
short, into the body, swung lustily across the line, top-edged through fine leg! Off the glove in fact, but they all count!
pushed into the off side, on the back foot

straight up in the air, du Plessis calls early and Head is gone! Made toom to leg again, Ferguson followed him into the blockhole, cramping the swing of his bat. A steepler to mid-off, but no mistake from the skipper. What a knock that was!
hits the pitch and nip off the seam back into Klaasen, who finds a deflected single
in the slot, slammed into the stands! Klaasen stands and delivers over midwicket! Angle into the pads, and the arc of the bat left that ball's destination in no doubt!
banged in short, hauled to mid-on. Klaasen has barely got started but he's still ticking at 150
opens the face for a dab to deep third

that is lethal hitting and up comes a 39-ball hundred! The fourth-fastest in IPL history, and it comes up with a sizzlingly fast flat clip through wide long-on, seizing the full length on the pads with impeccable timing! Bissecting two fielders, neither of whom had time to move
nicked away down through the off side, a scamper to intercept at short third
short, and swung high over the leg-side! Didn't get proper hold of it, but there's no-one fine enough to intercept that. The 150 is up in the 12th over!
clobbered through the covers, and Head marches into the 90s!
tucked off the toes, into the leg-side for another single. Still nine overs to go... gulp!
too far outside off, but at least he's bowling to his field
flat-batted into the covers, can't connect properly for a rare dot-ball
too far out of the hitting arc as Head shapes to cut
full length outside off, glided into the covers with a classical drive
attacking the legs, back of a length, nudged behind square and a good hard first run creates the second
pounded across the line as Klaasen comes to the party! Slower ball, into the pitch, and dispatched over midwicket!
back of a length on the pads, clipped firmly behind square, and Topley slides well to intercept a fast-travelling ball
pulled across the line, back of a length, midwicket gathers
well bowled, hits a good line and length, and Klaasen is beaten outside off, a hint of indecision
yanked across the line, one bounce to long-on, as he loses his shape a touch in the shot
onto the full length and pushed to mid-off
jeepers! That's preposterous! Wasn't desperately short, but Head just opened his stance, waited for the ball a fraction longer and launched it over square leg!
line and length from Ferguson, eased into the covers on the front foot, a slight misfield but no damage done
makes room to leg again, and picked off through backward point! That was a decent over from Topley but it's still gone for 11. What's going to happen to the next bad over?!
yorker, very well directed, and dug out, back to the bowler
fuller length, and filleted through deep third! Opens the face, right back on the stumps, giving himself room to leg to open up the off side
pace off on the slow bouncer, Head has about three different wafts as he tries to put bat on ball, but it's too short for the umpire's liking
opens the face on the back foot, picks off the single to backward point
a touch too wide, Topley hits the pitch hard but it swings beyond Klaasen's long reach
takes a sighter, placing bat on ball back down the line

whipped off the toes, out to deep square leg.... and finally a wicket for RCB! Topley in the wickets after that bruising first over. Abhishek couldn't make proper contact on his clip... but is this respite? Is it heck. Here's Heinrich!
dragged into the leg side, a tidier end to that over for RCB. Though all things are relative
flat-batted slap through the line, long-off gathers
heaved across the line, almost connects too well with deep midwicket lurking. But on the bounce for the single
cracked into the covers for the single
hint of swing back into the left-hander, a cramped defensive push to point for the single
No standing on ceremony here! In the slot on a wide line, who cares about taking a look at the new bowler. Just swung dismissively through the line, mighty over long-off!
clipped into the leg-side, another single to complete the over
width this time, Head reaches for a cut to deep point and picks off the single to the sweeper
dragged down from Jacks, and Head hoists him over midwicket again! Seven sixes already for Head!
that's contemptuous! Steps down the track, yawns into a vast slog-sweep, up and over midwicket!
down the pitch, cuffed through backward point! Placed through the infield for another boundary
helped on its way round the corner to backward square. Jacks is burgling a very economical spell by the standards around him...
down the leg-side, attempted flick off the pads, but deflects off the keeper instead
driven hard again, Kohli in the covers dives to cut off the boundary. That's a 20-run over to finish the powerplay. RCB need a time-out, and so do I!
back of a length, lambasted through the covers! Head marches through to a 20-ball fifty, aided on this occasion by a fractional misfield
hoisted over deep midwicket! This is too short, and Head is seeing it too well for it to go unpunished!
toe-ended on the kneeling drive! Pace off from Dayal and Head is momentarily confounded. But the ball plugs safely at long-off, as they come back for two more
this one is! Guileless pitch-hitting outside off, and slotted over wide long-on for another six!
hacked out to deep point... and falls just short of the man... not quite half a chance but at least it wasn't a boundary...
lumped over long-off! Head is seeing it like a comet already, leans into the fuller length and drives it for a one-bounce four
up on the toes, opens the face for a deflection down to deep third, just the single
pushed back into the crease, a wafty drive to deep cover, and a misfield gifts the run
panned over midwicket! Full or short, it matters not! Back of a length this time, and swivelled into the stands!
leg-sided, on the pads, and clipped with such timing over square leg! Head is right back on his stumps, takes on the boundary rider and clears him with ease!
good wheels from over the wicket, hitting the pitch hard and hopping over an attempted uppercut
clubbed out to the point sweeper. Dayal gets out of his over well
bends back in, good use of the variation, on the wide line again but shaping inside Head's intentions. This has been a good comeback from RCB so far
more lively carry outside off, a swish and a miss... any contact and that flies!
tapped for the single into the off side
much better! Big appeal from Dayal but that was just a good delivery, tighter line, climbing off the seam and zipping round the outside edge. Dragged the batter's hands into an airy flinch
width again, and this time Abhishek is wise to it, and simply throws his hands through the ball. High over backward point
hits the pitch hard from over the wicket, but the swing takes it too far out of Abhishek's arc. Only just mind, I thought that was a good ball
clubbed through the line, another single to long-off, but that's a good over for RCB, applying a bit of a brake
tapped off the legs into the on-side
attempted launch across the line, can't make contact
fuller length, weight leaning into the drive, punched to cover for the single
back of a length, hint of slow turn, cracked hard off the back foot to short cover
on the back foot, cramped on the angle into the pads, punched to the off-side
you can't bowl there! Sliding down the leg side, back of a length, Sharma swings with the angle and picks up sweetly over backward square. A brutal first over for Topley
on the back foot, tapped behind point for the single. It's been an ominous opening gambit from Head
flapped into the on-side, plugs in the deep, back they come for the second
melted down the ground! Clears that front leg, swings through the line, head still at point of impact and high over the ropes
Head's first boundary of the innings and that's typical Head. Not a lot of footwork, just a confident eye and fast hands, flashed off the pads through the leg side
back of a length, hint of shape away from the left-hander, poked out to cover from deep in the crease
leans forward, head over the ball, solid block back down the track
on the legs, nudged to the on-side
leans back and smacks an uppercut over point! Good weight transfer as the ball gripped from back of a length, and helped up and over
steps down the track and glides a drive to deep cover to open SRH's account with a comfortable two
punched off the back foot into the covers
round the wicket, slow turn from outside off, angled in then bending away. No stroke offered
fourth four of the over and he does it by going low to scoop it away fine on the leg side. Four fours in the over from Rawat which ends in 18 from it
he goes wide outside off, and Rawat frees his arms with a booming drive over the covers for a cracking four!
in the block hole to Vyshak and he digs it out for a single to mid-on
short and wide with the angle, slashes it away for one
he swings big this time for the full toss outside off, doesn't quite connect but enough to make it sail over short third for four more!
almost a wide yorker, Rawat stays deep while going across and opens the face late to do a Karthik and collect a four fine on the off side
in the block hole from wide of the crease, Vyshak digs it out to cover

tickled behind to the keeper and that's it for Karthik! He made room by backing away, the ball was well outside off and his swing only resulted in an edge for the keeper. What a knock from a man who is ready to retire, and almost kept RCB in the game right till the end
fuller towards the stumps and it's flicked wide of long-on for two
Karthik is doing what he wants tonight and getting away with it! Short of length outside off, pretty slow too, and he waits before steering it fine like a reverse lap, and it's gone fine for four

tries the block hole, doesn't quite nail it, and Karthik launches it into the leg side again where Phillips almost takes an excellent catch while diving to his right before the other fielder dives behind him to keep the ball rolling towards the rope
poor delivery and put away with disdain! On the pads, no need to move much, just connect with the flick and watch it land in the crowd
gets the yorker right this time around off and Karthik drives it away for one to keep strike
Karthik stays still again but Bhuvneshwar wants the ball far from him and sends a wide well outside off

a spectacular switch hit for six! Karthik has batted like a left-hand batter there. He gets into position quickly with a hop for a switch and crashes that over what was the point boundary initially. Right off the middle!
this time Karthik stays still and this one is easily a wide well outside off
a long way outside off, slow and wide, and Karthik has gone after it, chasing it all the way but missed it altogether and it's called a wide
some width outside off, he slashes it away for one to deep point
right in the block hole! Karthik does well to get bat on it right at the base of middle stump and even gets a single to short third
Bhuvneshwar thinks he's got Rawat lbw, having trapped him right in front, but it's not given out. Was there an edge? Sunrisers review and the replay shows an edge straightaway
133.3kmh, shorter and quicker, just inside the wide line
tries to keep it away from the batter and it ends up as a wide
ends his night with another short ball, and Karthik doesn't mind it at all. He probably expected it, came inside the line and pulled it away for a six over fine leg
too short and that's gone over Karthik's head for a wide
116.4kmh, slows it down further for Rawat who stays deep and drills it down to long-off for one
121.1kmh, takes the pace off for the short ball and Karthik pulls it away for one
goes after the ball with hard hands outside off, can't beat mid-off
pulls again, but this time for two to deep midwicket
slow and short, Karthik gets on top of it and middles that pull handsomely right off the meat of the bat. The crowd comes alive again. and that's his fifty off 23 balls!
full toss wide outside off and Karthik slaps it over the covers for one, keeps strike too
cleverly bowled. Slow and short at 117.2kmh just outside off, Rawat waits and waits before trying to ramp it but misses it altogether. They sneak in a bye though
full and slightly wide, this time Karthik connects and slices it away for one

tries the wide yorker to bowl it away from Karthik. Not given a wide and RCB review it. Karthik didn't move at all from his original stance and it's just around the tram line, called wide by the third umpire. It was very close
slow and short, cutting away too, and he almost leaves it at the end. Klaasen fumbles but they don't go for a bye
nearly in the block hole and Karthik digs it out to the leg side for two quick runs
almost out of the stadium! Karthik has absolutely smoked that off his pads on the leg side, it's hit the roof and comes back down to planet Earth. He deserves more than six runs for that
ends the over with a four, but still only six from it! Some more width from Cummins and Rawat rocks back to cut it away with some power to the point boundary
just a hint of width and he slices it straight to point
Cummins has kept fine leg deep for Karthik. Sends down a short ball at 121.3kmh and Karthik waits before pulling it fine to the fielder for one
tight on off stump, Rawat sends it square with soft hands for one
full on middle and he pushes it back

chopped on and Cummins has got them a breakthrough again! Short ball with no room at all, rising on off stump as he rolls his fingers over it, and Lomror slices it with an inside edge onto his stumps. The crowd has gone silent again
Unadkat changes things but gets the same result! He targets the stumps for a change, and Karthik goes down and across to sweep that away to the fine leg boundary. He loves that area, doesn't he!
poor bowling continues. it's slow and wide outside off and called a wide too
too predictable and it's smoked for six! Slow again, wide outside off and Karthik reaches out for it outside off to launch it to the long-on boundary and that brings up the 50 partnership
bangs in a slow bouncer and Lomror pulls it away somehow for one
makes the length tighter and Karthik can't put it away this time, a single to cover
slow and wide again, this was even shorter and Karthik slaps that away to the cover boundary, off the middle of the bat this time. And the stadium has come alive again!
110.2kmh, slow and wide, easily enough room for Karthik to free his arms and a thick edge sends that flying over short third for a four
88.9kmh, flatter and wider, swatted down to long-on for one
a googly well outside off, it's so slow that Karthik switches around in his stance and sweeps that away for the first four of the over
too slow and very wide outside off, easily a wide
into the stands behind square! A rare loose delivery from Markande. Sliding down leg, Karthik shuffles to off as well and he slaps that away very high on the leg side for a six
slower at 84.8kmh, goes back and cuts that away for one
square and flat and it's six more! Goes down quickly for a sweep as it's pitched up, looked like a googly, and he middled that for a clean six!
pretty slow around off, Lomror swings down the ground and long-off was in the game for a bit, but the ball has just cleared him. A boundary after 16 balls
slightly wide yorker to Lomror as well and he bunts it down to long-off. Keeps the strike
a wide yorker that Karthik puts away to deep point for one
120.7kmh, takes the pace off with the angle outside off and Karthik chases and misses
137.7kmh, he backs away for the length ball on stumps and can't quite connect for a single over the bowler's head
attempted yorker goes wrong and that's a wide down leg
bangs in a short one and that's called a wide for height
132.6kmh, short of good length around off with the angle and Karthik pulls to long-on for one
short and wide, wide enough to be called wide and it's one bouncer for the over too
angling into the body and he clips it away for one
outside off and he cuts it away for one to deep point
84.5kmh, loopy googly to Karthik now and he covers the line to nudge it to leg
much straighter this time and he pulls it away for one
a half-tracker going way outside off, called a wide

big appeal for lbw, it looked very close, but the umpire doesn't move. Cummins comes close to the pitch and signals for a review. Nice and loopy googly from Markande right on middle stump, Lomror goes across for a sweep and misses it, and he's saved by Umpire's call for just clipping off stump
outside off again and this time he sweeps it square for one
full outside off and driven straight to cover

gone first ball! Second wicket in the over for Cummins and he is pushing RCB's hopes down a hill. Around the wicket to the left-hand batter and that was quick at 146kmh, and hit him full on the pads right in front of the stumps. The umpire raised his finger in slow motion as soon as they appealed
nice and tight outside off, Karthik defends like it's a Test match, for a single

Cummins thinks he has another! He appealed for a tickle down leg this time which the on-field umpire didn't give and Cummins has gone for a review. Replays show it's the thigh pad, nothing on UltraEdge for the bat

tickled through to the keeper and the captain is gone! RCB are crumbling here all of a sudden. It was a slow bouncer which du PLessies tried to put away as the ball went over him, but all he managed was a thin edge
launched wide of long-on for six! Du Plessis is putting the pressure back on Hyderabad. Made a hint of room and smacked that down the ground for a big one
tries to cramp him for room like Cummins did in his first over but du Plessis does well to adjust and swipe it away towards fine leg in the gap

holes out while attempting another big one! Pitched up on middle with some drift, Patidar swings big on the leg side towards the longest part of the boundary and he finds Nitish Reddy placed in between deep midwicket and long-on. Caught right at the rope
goes down the ground again, this time to the right of long-on and it doesn't carry so they settle for two
too slow and wide, he lets it go and it's called a wide
89.7kmh, flatter and straighter and this time Patidar has smacked it back with a quick swing, bang into the sight screen
slows it down to 80.5kmh outside off, and Patidar waits before steering to short third
not a lot of pace, and du Plessis swings big but only for one to leg
coming in towards the pads and he tucks it fine for one

drilled back and Jacks is outside his crease while the bails have gone off after a deflection! Jacks might be kicking himself for that. Du Plessis hit it straight back, it went off Unadkat's right hand as he went down and got just enough to deflect it to the stumps
slow, wide and going away further. That's a poor delivery and du Plessis slashes that over short third after cashing in on the width
slow and wide, Jacks chases it for a single to sweeper cover
a clever slow bouncer at 110kmh, and Jacks does well to adjust and get some bat off the hook to send that for four fine on leg
takes the pace off as he often does and du Plessis waits before slicing to point
130.1kmh, starts with a short ball and du Plessis has launched that over the deep square boundary with a mighty pull that sails all the way!
too short with width outside off but du Plessis can only reach out for a single to long off
swings across the line and gets a single off the googly to short fine leg
goes back in the crease and works it down to long-on for one more
tight on the stumps on length and he pushes it down for one

Kohli has been castled! Chinnaswamy has been silenced because Markande has beaten the top-scorer of this IPL with some skill. Slows that down beautifully to 83.7kmh, it's a googly too, and Kohli goes for a sweep with hard hands but he misses it completely and looks back in horror
coming into the batter from off, worked down to long-off
makes room for the last ball and smokes that back over du Plessis' head for four. Takes advantage of the last ball of the powerplay and gets another four
angling into Kohli as well, even he can't put it away off the swipe
short of good length, he wants to slap it back but is hit high on the bat so only a single to mid-off
143.8kmh, just like the first ball but much quicker and it's angled into him at good pace. Du Plessis has been hit right in the batteries and he's crouching for a short break
much straighter and this time du Plessis sends that crashing back over the bowler's head. Off the middle despite decent bounce, on the up and it's four
137.6kmh, angles it into the body and du Plessis can't connect. It goes off the pad to the keeper
full toss to end the over and guess what's the treatment? On the pads and flicked to the square leg boundary, the ball is lost in the crowd
heaves down the ground, he hasn't middled that either, but the field is not spread out yet and he beats mid-off by a few yards
almost kisses leg stump! Kohli charges down to flick it away but Natarajan has pitched it right in the block hole and beats the batter completely.
that's gone high on the off side off a slice and goes for four! Didn't look like it would beat the fielder initially, but Kohli swung hard and even though he sliced it high, it beat point eventually
137.2kmh, du Plessis pulls the slightly short ball and there's cover in the deep on leg, so just a single
swings it into the leg side and gets a single to deep square leg for one
fourth four of the over! Slightly short, no fielder in the deep on leg and du Plessis targets the same boundary again. Almost middles it and it's a short boundary there
goes for the pull again and this one doesn't swing as much, du Plessis sends that racing to the midwicket boundary
heaves and misses! Swinging in from outside off from length, du Plessis goes for a big swing but doesn't connect at all
short of length outside off, taps it to cover point for one
swishes at it outside off, it wasn't a bad ball, but the ball takes a flying edge and sails fine on the off side for a on-bounce four
too short for Kohli and he stands tall to pull that away just wide of mid-on in the vacant gap. Middled for four!

is that another six! Might have landed straight on the boundary ropes. Shahbaz slowed it down, du Plessis swiped at it down the ground and even though he didn't look very convincing, he had enough on it
cuts off the back foot for a dive at backward point and yet he takes off for a single because du Plessis was a long way down and Kohli makes it
some room and he drives to wide long-off for one
makes a lot of room for the full ball on middle and he has sent that into the orbit! Lofted a long way over the cover boundary for massive cheers from the crowd. Goes all the way
backs away just a bit and drives into the covers
du Plessis swings outside off and he too gets an edge, four runs fine on the off side because short third is in the circle
comes down a step and drives but can't clear mid off
flicked for six, the crowd loves this! Too full and Kohli is not going to spare that. Excellent timing to roll his wrists over that one right in the end and it lands in the crowd

just over short third for four! Kohli is living dangerously but that might be the only way to go tonight. Gets a thick edge outside off for a slash and it just goes over the fielder leaping in the circle
swings and misses! Comes down the track for a heave but Bhuvneshwar has slowed it down and it goes over the bat with spongy bounce
good bounce outside off at 133.7kmh, Kohli steers to backward point
swinging in and du Plessis clips it for one to fine leg
is this what is called rubbing salt in the wounds? Shorter length and Kohli rocks back to pull that to the square leg boundary for four
Kohli has been put down! Abhishek gets a quick return catch and for some reason he doesn't go for it with both hands. Sticks his right hand out after Kohli smacks it back and it doesn't stick there
connects with the flick this time for a single to the leg side
makes room and Abhishek follows him to cramp him up, du Plessis can barely connect

turn outside off and that's been edged away for four! Du Plessis didn't move his feet at all and went after that ball well outside off and was going away further, thick edge and he'll taker those four runs
pitched up first ball on middle with some drift and Kohli adjusts to flick it away for one
